context: Theorem 7. We conjecture that the actual soundness error is 1 − Ω(1). In particular, we propose the following number-theoretic conjecture under which the soundness error is indeed 1 − Ω(1): ▶ Conjecture 9 (Strong Descartes’ Rule Conjecture over Finite Fields). There are constants ε, δ < 1 such that the following holds. Let p, q be sufficiently large prime numbers such that q | p − 1, g ∈ Fq be an element of order g, and G ≜ ⟨g⟩ be the unique multiplicative subgroup of F∗p of order q. For any k ≤ q δ , distinct α1 , . . . , αk ∈ Fq , and β1 , . . . , βk ∈ Fp \ {0}, the non-zero univariate polynomial f (z) ≜ β1 z α1 + β2 z α2 + · · · + βk z αk has at most ε · q roots in G.
